cards.name: Sample residential rate with net metering
cards.effective: a sample: example values, not a published schedule
cards.note: Shipped with Enthalix so a run can be priced before you have your utility's schedule. The values are an example of a residential cooperative rate (2025): a monthly access charge, a delivery charge per kWh, a small demand charge, and a supply charge per kWh that is higher in summer. They are not any utility's rates. Use Search… to find your own utility's schedule, and enter it as a card of your own.

deliveryUsdKwh.cite: sample: the energy delivery charge, every kWh delivered

demandUsdKw.cite: sample: the demand charge, on the month's highest hourly kW between 6:00 and 23:00

demandWindow.cite: sample: billing demand is the highest 60-minute kW in any hour from 6:00 to 23:00 in the month

minimum.cite: sample: the minimum monthly charge is the access charge

rules: you are billed on the residential rate above
in a billing period when generation exceeds use, only the fixed charges are paid, and the excess is a credit
credits carry forward to the next billing periods with net use
at the end of a 12-month period, credits beyond that period's billed use are not paid for
